instructions.default_render: Load graphics/atlases/<district>.png and draw the atlas_rect_px using anchor_px as the ground contact point.
instructions.alternative_render: Use each prop's individual transparent sprite_file without loading atlases.
instructions.collision: suggested_footprint_tiles is a visual starting point, not a validated collision model.
instructions.random_spawning: Choose props from the matching district prop_ids; use suggested_spawn_weight as relative weight and revise for your maps.
instructions.transparency: All exported sprites have real alpha; transparent 8-pixel padding helps prevent texture bleeding.
instructions.scale: Source is large hand-painted artwork; scale sprites to your game world before use.

design_scope: Fictional fan-game interpretations, not official prop designs or street-by-street evidence.

districts.label: The Shades
districts.art_direction: Old alleys, improvised repairs, ramshackle benches, refuse and dim lights
districts.lore_basis: The Shades is an old and famously dangerous part of the city. The particular objects are original artistic interpretations.

districts.label: The Docks / riverfront
districts.art_direction: Wharves, moorings, fishing gear, cargo and water-soaked timbers
districts.lore_basis: The city has commercial docks and a heavily polluted river; placements and cargo designs are interpretation.

districts.label: Park Lane / affluent Ankh-side streets
districts.art_direction: Well-kept lamps, decorative railings, planters, civic fountains and parcel deliveries
districts.lore_basis: Park Lane borders an affluent residential area; these ornamental props are a visual interpretation, not canonical objects.

districts.label: Dolly Sisters / theatrical market streets
districts.art_direction: Community celebrations, theatre motifs, traders, bunting and flower stalls
districts.lore_basis: Dolly Sisters has distinctive festivals and local amateur theatre; assigning these exact props to it is artistic extrapolation.

districts.label: Wizards' Quarter / Unseen University
districts.art_direction: Scholarly benches, globes, astronomy lecterns, book carts and magical laboratories
districts.lore_basis: Unseen University and the Wizards' Quarter are established settings. Specific signage and ornaments are invented for this pack.

districts.label: Pseudopolis Yard / Isle of Gods
districts.art_direction: Formal civic lamps, Watch signs, theatre posters, railings, benches and ornamental fountains
districts.lore_basis: The Isle of Gods contains Pseudopolis Yard, the Watch headquarters and Opera House; pictured furniture and heraldry are illustrative.
